meta.name: telegram
meta.description: This skill should be used when fetching, searching, downloading, sending, editing, or publishing messages on Telegram. Use for queries like "show my Telegram messages", "search Telegram for...", "get unread messages", "send a message to...", "edit that message", "publish this draft to klodkot", or "add Telegram messages to my notes".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Telegram上自动处理消息
copy.tagline_en: Fetch, send, and edit Telegram messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate Telegram message handling

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取、搜索、发送、编辑和发布 Telegram 消息，并支持下载附件、管理论坛主题、将消息保存到本地文件或 Obsidian 笔记。
howto.when: 当你要求查看、搜索、发送、编辑或发布 Telegram 消息时触发，例如“显示我的 Telegram 消息”、“搜索 Telegram 中的...”、“发送消息给...”、“编辑那条消息”、“发布草稿到 klodkot”等。

say.text: 显示我最近 20 条 Telegram 消息
say.note: Claude 会运行 recent 命令并返回结果。

say.text: 搜索 Telegram 中关于“项目”的消息
say.note: Claude 会执行 search 命令并展示匹配内容。
Claude 会使用 send 命令发送消息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, search, send, edit, and publish Telegram messages, download attachments, manage forum threads, and save messages to local files or Obsidian notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view, search, send, edit, or publish Telegram messages, e.g., "show my Telegram messages", "search Telegram for...", "send a message to...", "edit that message", "publish this draft to klodkot".

say_en.note: Claude runs the recent command and returns results.
Claude executes the search command and shows matches.
Claude uses the send command to send the message.
